# `aitbc network test`

Test connectivity to a specific peer address. By default the command probes the peer's public API gateway at https://<peer>/health. If an explicit --rpc-url is given, it probes that base URL's /health endpoint instead.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network test [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--peer` | text | — | yes | Peer address to test |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network test --peer <peer>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network test --peer <peer> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
